purpose: Independent synthetic candidate demonstration for the uCloudify Junior Software Developer application
candidate_disclaimer: AlpineBank is fictional. No uCloudify client data, internal repositories, proprietary architecture, production credentials, or confidential processes are represented or used.

quality_rules.DQ-01: transaction_id must be unique within a batch
quality_rules.DQ-02: currency must be an allowed ISO-style currency code
quality_rules.DQ-03: amount must be a valid Decimal-compatible monetary value
quality_rules.DQ-04: required canonical fields must not be empty
quality_rules.DQ-05: retrying the same batch must not create a second import

financial_invariants.FIN-01: every accepted record is counted exactly once
financial_invariants.FIN-02: duplicate input never enters the verified dataset
financial_invariants.FIN-03: every input record has an explicit accepted or quarantined outcome
financial_invariants.FIN-04: reconciliation is derived only from accepted records
financial_invariants.FIN-05: replaying the same batch creates no second dataset

technology_ownership.python: primary ingestion, validation, transformation, reconciliation and future MCP domain logic
technology_ownership.azure: future cloud execution/storage boundary; local deterministic mode remains mandatory
technology_ownership.frontend: candidate presentation only; not the source of domain truth
technology_ownership.ai: future explanation layer over controlled evidence; never quality/reconciliation authority

prohibited_scope: live LLM dependency for the golden path
